parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity or expression, and no documented universal traveler-facing restriction: no bathroom rule, no border document regime touching visitors, no organised police targeting. Socially, gender diversity is visible and partly accepted (military inclusion, school uniform policy, patchwork local SOGI ordinances). Against this: documented trans-specific violence with raw counts and no denominator (two 2025 killings, NHRC 'disturbing pattern', plus older killings by militias) — background-level at most, but present; scattered harassment and service refusal with thin national recourse (equality bill stalled 25 years, rejected by government); two unenforced local dress ordinances; and a documented custody exposure — birth-sex jail placement with head-shaving and unsafe dorms, mitigated only inconsistently (one annex practice). That is tier-3 societal hostility with partial recourse plus a partial custody exposure, not tier-1 universal exclusion and not tier-2 organised targeting. The NHRC investigating but lacking enforcement power leaves remedies thin, holding it below the 0.65 band; the absence of criminalisation, patchwork protections, and acceptance signals hold it above 0.45.
